newsitem.title: UK: FORECAST-UK housing revival to boost MFI.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-UK housing revival to boost MFI.

text.p: MFI Furniture Group Plc is set to almost double first half profits when it reports results next Monday, with strong earnings growth driven by Britain's housing market revival and improvements in gross margins, analysts said.

Britain's market leader in furniture retailing and manufacturing is set to make pretax profits of around 38 million pounds, up from 20.1 million in last year's first half, analysts say. The dividend is forecast to increase to between 1.7 pence and 1.9 pence from 1.5 pence last time.

Analysts said sales may not have kept pace with the 17 percent increase seen in the first 21 weeks of the current half year reported in September. But if the profit figure is sufficiently strong there will be full year profit forecast upgrades, they said. Existing forecasts are in the region of 86 million to 90 million pounds.

"Sales are good and there has been a near three percentage point gain in gross margin," said one retail analyst. This has come from a mixture of a softening in raw material prices and the sales mix shifting towards higher margin products.

The company is in the process of converting stores to its new format MFI Homeworks, which have tended to perform better than the rest of the chain. In September MFI said it had converted 61 of its stores to the Homeworks style.
